answer_4.quote: We invite the annotators to assess whether the extracted concepts are correct ... All annotators are native Chinese and proficient in English. Each concept is labeled with 0, 1 or 2 by three annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label each extracted concept as 0 (wrong), 1 (existing concept), or 2 (new concept).
